_comment_pass: Password field — on some pools (e.g. supportxmr) this is used as the worker name shown in the dashboard
_comment_worker: Worker ID sent as rigid field in stratum login
_comment_threads: Number of mining threads (max 8). Match to your big core count for best results
_comment_mode: full = 2GB dataset (needs ~2.5GB free RAM), light = 256MB (for devices with 4GB RAM or less)
